LESSON: HOLINESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.6: Holiness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Holiness
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you lead holy lives as young people?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies
2. recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

Teach
• Today’s focus: recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit” using a school example.
• Model B for “recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies
• Model 2: recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies
2. Practise: recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Holiness.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you lead holy lives as young people?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies
• recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
